sources.intro: Catavento brings together public information from many places. Every record shows where it came from and when it was checked. This page lists every source, what we use from it, how often we check it, and the credit we show.
sources.tierGreenText: Public directories, openly licensed data and official services. We show the facts with a credit and a link.
sources.tierAmberText: Public but run by volunteers, without published terms, or sensitive to traffic. We take only facts and short labels, link to the full content, check rarely, and tell the owner what we use.
sources.tierRedText: Their terms don't allow automated collection, or the content needs a login. We collect nothing and only link to them.
sources.creditNote: Words in italics are filled in for each record, for example the club's name.
sources.changesText: If you look after one of these sources and would like us to change or stop using anything, tell us and we'll act on it, usually within 24 hours.
